summary_1line: Kadru enslaves Vinata after winning the horse wager, while the newly born Garuda dazzles the gods, calms them, and departs carrying Aruna eastward.

image_candidates.scene_text: The newborn Garuda erupts from the egg blazing like a heap of fire, his vast wings lighting the sky as the startled gods scatter in their celestial chariots.
The radiant bird Garuda shrinks his immense blazing form while the gathered gods and rishis bow before him in the heavens.
Garuda flies across the ocean with Aruna on his back, placing him in the eastern sky as the rising sun prepares to scorch the worlds.
